_rationale: The other cli/git spec (`--scope wip`) is envelope-only by construction: MaterializeGitFixture always leaves a clean tree, so wip's `git diff HEAD` is deterministically empty. `--scope commit` (default base_ref HEAD) instead diffs the fixture's single root commit via `diff-tree --root`, so the whole fixture is read as Added. The fixture's `huge.go` defines a 130-line function, past the fixed long_function threshold (100 lines) unconditionally, and `duplicate.go` defines two functions with identical bodies and different names, above the 0.8 structural-similarity threshold -- both independent of the live index's other contents, so both findings are deterministic across hosts and runs. Stable tier pins that both findings exist and names the symbols; ref/severity/line-number detail that would churn on unrelated fixture edits stays in ignore.
